method: Every distinct finding/assertion in the prior audit corpus, each pinned to file:line, tagged by class, then independently spot-verified against 2026-09-26 bytes where cheap. UNVERIFIED means I did not check it, not that it is false.

status_legend.VERIFIED: I confirmed it against bytes this pass
status_legend.VERIFIED-DIRECTION: magnitude/shape confirmed; the exact figure is lane-dated
status_legend.VERIFIED-BY-PRIOR-LANE: strong prior receipt with a named method; I did not re-walk it
status_legend.UNVERIFIED: not checked by me; do not repeat as fact
status_legend.UNVERIFIED-BY-ME: cited but explicitly out of my verification budget
status_legend.OPEN-AND-WORSE: the named condition recurred or grew since
status_legend.SUPERSEDED: a later measurement replaced the number
status_legend.LIVE-POINTER: binding doc lives outside the audit root
